derivation: from H4964 (מֶתֶג) and H520 (אַמָּה) with the art. interposed; bit of the metropolis;

occurrences.text: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Metheg–ammah out of the hand of the Philistines.
